meta.name: Score and route job candidates with Mistral, Gemini, Google Sheets, and Drive

parameters.content:
## AI-HR Auto-Candidate selection

### How it works

Triggered by a candidate submitting an application form containing their resume.\nExtracts resume text and queries matching roles from Google Sheets.\nPresents candidates with interactive selection forms to choose the position they are applying for.\nRetrieves the full job description from Google Docs and uses Google Gemini to evaluate the candidate's fit.\nDecides whether to shortlist the candidate based on the structured AI response.\nUploads both the resume and AI evaluation reports to Google Drive, then triggers automated selection or rejection emails via Gmail.

### Setup steps

- - [ ] Create and configure Google Gemini API credentials for the LLM chat model.
- - [ ] Connect your Google Workspace account to enable Google Sheets and Google Docs nodes.
- - [ ] Authorize Google Drive access to organize, save, and manage candidate portfolios.
- - [ ] Set up Gmail credentials to automatically trigger candidate communications.
- - [ ] Prepare your Google Sheet with active jobs and ensure Google Docs contain relevant Job Descriptions.

### Customization

Adjust the comparison prompt in the ConstructPrompt node to modify candidate evaluation guidelines or scoring metrics.\nChange the email templates in Gmail nodes to match your brand's candidate experience guidelines.

## Receive application and parse resume

Receives candidate application through an interactive form and uses Mistral AI to convert the resume into plain text.

## Query and filter active jobs

Fetches active job openings from Google Sheets, filters them by department, and determines if matching roles are available.

## Interactive role selection

Presents the candidate with a selection form of open positions, handles success feedback, or routes to an error page if no jobs are open.

## Retrieve matching job description

Filters active job descriptions by the chosen role and fetches the full requirements from Google Docs.

## Perform AI candidate evaluation

Builds a detailed comparison prompt and evaluates the candidate's resume against job requirements using Google Gemini AI, outputting structured results.

## Evaluate candidate qualification

Converts structured AI output into a file format and branches the execution path based on whether the candidate is shortlisted.

## Process shortlisted applicant

Prepares directories, uploads resume and evaluation insights to Google Drive, and sends a selection email via Gmail.

## Process rejected applicant

Prepares rejection data, saves applicant profile and AI feedback to Google Drive, and sends a formal rejection email via Gmail.

const resumeText = $('Extract Resume with Mistral').first().json.extractedText;
const jdText = $('Fetch Job Description from Docs').first().json.content;
const candidateName = $('When Application Submitted').first().json.Name;
const role = $('Show Job Selection Form').first().json.jobTitle;

const prompt = `
You are an expert technical recruiter and ATS screening assistant.

Your task is to evaluate a candidate's resume against the provided job description and produce a strict JSON evaluation.

IMPORTANT RULES:
- Evaluate ONLY using evidence explicitly present in the resume.
- Never assume a skill, experience, responsibility, or qualification exists because it is common for the role.
- If a requirement is not mentioned in the resume, treat it as missing.
- Do not reward technologies that are only implied.
- Be objective and conservative in scoring.
- Do not include personal opinions or bias.


ROLE:
${role}

CANDIDATE NAME:
${candidateName}

JOB DESCRIPTION:
${jdText}

RESUME:
${resumeText}


INPUT DOCUMENT VALIDATION:

Before performing any scoring, first verify that the provided RESUME is actually a candidate resume/CV.

A valid CV must contain evidence of a candidate profile, such as:
- Candidate name or personal details
- Work experience, internships, freelance work, or professional projects
- Employment dates, duration, roles, achievements, or responsibilities
- Education, certifications, or academic background
- Skills connected to the candidate's own experience

Invalid documents include:
- Technical documentation
- Software architecture documents
- Product requirement documents
- Project proposals
- Tutorials
- Articles
- Job descriptions
- Random text
- Documents containing only technology names without candidate history

IMPORTANT:
- Do not consider a document a CV only because it contains programming languages, frameworks, cloud platforms, or technical keywords.
- A list of technologies, system designs, architecture diagrams, or project descriptions without candidate ownership/history is not sufficient evidence of candidate skills or experience.
- Do not evaluate technical documents, project specifications, or documentation as if they represent candidate experience.

If the RESUME is invalid:

Return the required JSON structure with:
- overallScore: 0
- experienceScore: 0
- technicalSkillsScore: 0
- responsibilitiesScore: 0
- educationScore: 0
- softSkillsScore: 0
- matchedSkills: []
- candidateSkills: []
- missingMandatorySkills: []
- missingPreferredSkills: []
- candidateExperienceYears: 0

candidateSummary:
"Invalid resume document provided."

reason:
"Evaluation stopped because the uploaded document does not contain sufficient evidence of a candidate resume, employment history, education, or professional background."


SCORING INSTRUCTIONS:

First, identify the scoring weights from the job description.

If the JD contains custom weights, use those weights.

If no weights are provided, use:

- Experience: 25%
- Technical Skills: 40%
- Responsibilities Match: 20%
- Education: 5%
- Soft Skills: 10%


GENERAL SCORE CALIBRATION:

Use these scoring ranges:

90-100:
Exceptional match. Candidate clearly exceeds or fully satisfies the requirement with strong evidence.

75-89:
Strong match. Candidate satisfies most requirements with minor gaps.

60-74:
Moderate match. Candidate satisfies some requirements but has noticeable gaps.

40-59:
Weak match. Limited evidence or partial alignment.

0-39:
Poor match. Requirement is mostly missing.


SCORING GUIDELINES:

Experience Score:
- Compare required years of experience against proven experience in the resume.
- Only count professional experience, internships, or projects if explicitly relevant.
- Do not count education duration as experience.
- Do not overestimate experience from projects alone.


Technical Skills Score:
- Compare mandatory and preferred skills from the JD against the resume.
- Mandatory skills should have higher impact.
- Only mark a JD skill as matched if it is explicitly mentioned or clearly demonstrated in the resume.
- Do not include related technologies as substitutes.
- Example: Node.js does not imply Next.js.
- Example: React does not imply React Native.
- Equivalent demonstrated experience is allowed.
- Example: "resolved production issues" demonstrates debugging ability.


Responsibilities Score:
- Compare each responsibility independently against evidence from the resume.
- Similar wording alone is not enough.
- Require meaningful evidence through projects, achievements, ownership, or delivered work.
- Consider measurable impact and real responsibilities.


Education Score:
- Evaluate education relevance and completion status separately.
- A degree currently in progress in the required field should receive strong credit.
- Reduce score only because the degree is incomplete, not because it is irrelevant.
- Do not heavily penalize education when the JD marks it as preferred.


Soft Skills Score:
- Score only based on evidence such as leadership, mentoring, collaboration, communication, teamwork, client interaction, or ownership.
- Do not infer soft skills only from job titles.


SKILL EXTRACTION RULES:

matchedSkills:
- Include only skills from the JOB DESCRIPTION that are found in the resume.
- This is used for JD matching and scoring.

candidateSkills:
- Extract ALL technical skills, programming languages, frameworks, libraries, databases, cloud platforms, infrastructure tools, security tools, testing tools, methodologies, and technologies explicitly mentioned in the resume.
- Do not limit this list to JD requirements.
- Do not infer technologies that are not present.
- Preserve important categories such as backend, frontend, cloud, databases, testing, security, and infrastructure.


STRICT MISSING EVIDENCE HANDLING:

If the resume does not provide explicit evidence for a required category, score that category as 0.

Examples:
- If no professional experience is mentioned, experienceScore must be 0.
- If no JD-required technical skills are explicitly found in the resume, technicalSkillsScore must be 0.
- If no responsibilities from the JD are demonstrated in the resume, responsibilitiesScore must be 0.
- If education information is missing, educationScore must be 0.
- If no evidence of communication, teamwork, leadership, ownership, collaboration, or client interaction exists, softSkillsScore must be 0.

When assigning a score of 0:
- Do not leave the reason empty.
- Clearly explain that the score is 0 because no explicit evidence was found in the resume.
- Do not penalize based on assumptions or missing formatting.
- A missing skill, qualification, or responsibility must always be treated as unavailable evidence.

Examples of valid reasons:
- "Technical Skills Score is 0 because the resume does not explicitly mention any of the required technologies from the job description."
- "Experience Score is 0 because the resume does not provide evidence of relevant professional experience."
- "Soft Skills Score is 0 because the resume does not include evidence of collaboration, leadership, communication, or ownership."

The evaluator must never give partial credit for assumed knowledge, related technologies, job titles, or industry expectations.


OUTPUT RULES:

CRITICAL:
- Return ONLY raw JSON.
- Do NOT use markdown formatting.
- Do NOT wrap JSON inside code blocks.
- The first character must be {
- The last character must be }


Return exactly this JSON structure:

{
  "overallScore": 0,
  "experienceScore": 0,
  "technicalSkillsScore": 0,
  "responsibilitiesScore": 0,
  "educationScore": 0,
  "softSkillsScore": 0,

  "matchedSkills": [],
  "candidateSkills": [],

  "missingMandatorySkills": [],
  "missingPreferredSkills": [],

  "candidateExperienceYears": 0,

  "candidateSummary": "",
  "reason": ""
}


Additional requirements:
- Scores must be numbers between 0 and 100.
- matchedSkills must only contain JD skills found in the resume.
- candidateSkills must contain all explicitly mentioned resume skills.
- missingMandatorySkills must only contain mandatory JD requirements missing from the resume.
- missingPreferredSkills must only contain preferred JD requirements missing from the resume.
- candidateSummary should briefly describe the candidate's profile, expertise, and experience level.
- reason must explain the score using evidence from the resume.
`;

return { json: { prompt } };

const folders = {
  Engineering: "1ESgh92tBTuU6EeAPN_iyMomRw9fB5iJ7",
  Finance: "1IkzOcy-uVo6196_2V0CsqNzl3Wq4t5lh",
  Sale: "11Dc8zbV4QOzKpdVo2j0aXsk0_wwDf2wv",
  CallCenter: "11Dc8zbV4QOzKpdVo2j0aXsk0_wwDf2wv"
};

const application = $('When Application Submitted').first();
const department = application.json["Select Department"];
const candidateName = application.json.Name;
const candidateMail = application.json.Email

// Read evaluation JSON from binary file
const evaluationBinary = $('Convert AI Results to File').first().binary;
const binaryKey = Object.keys(evaluationBinary)[0];

const jsonBuffer = await this.helpers.getBinaryDataBuffer(0, binaryKey);
const evaluationData = JSON.parse(jsonBuffer.toString());

const candidate = evaluationData[0]?.output || {};

const formatList = (items, prefix = "•") =>
  items?.length
    ? items.map(item => `${prefix} ${item}`).join("\n")
    : "None";

const report = `
=========================================
CANDIDATE EVALUATION REPORT
=========================================

Candidate Name:
${candidateName}

Candidate Gmail:
${candidateMail}

=========================================
EVALUATION SUMMARY
=========================================

Overall Match Score:
${candidate.overallScore ?? "N/A"}/100

Qualification Status:
Shortlisted for Initial Interview

Mandatory Requirements:
${
  candidate.missingMandatorySkills?.length
    ? `Missing ${candidate.missingMandatorySkills.length} requirement(s)`
    : "All Mandatory Requirements Met"
}

Preferred Requirements:
${
  candidate.missingPreferredSkills?.length
    ? `${candidate.missingPreferredSkills.length} Preferred Skill Gap(s) Identified`
    : "All Preferred Requirements Met"
}

=========================================
SCORING BREAKDOWN
=========================================

Technical Skills Score:
${candidate.technicalSkillsScore ?? "N/A"}/100

Experience Score:
${candidate.experienceScore ?? "N/A"}/100

Responsibilities Score:
${candidate.responsibilitiesScore ?? "N/A"}/100

Education Score:
${candidate.educationScore ?? "N/A"}/100

Soft Skills Score:
${candidate.softSkillsScore ?? "N/A"}/100


=========================================
EXPERIENCE
=========================================

Relevant Experience:
${candidate.candidateExperienceYears ?? "N/A"} Years


=========================================
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
=========================================

${candidate.candidateSummary || "No summary available."}


=========================================
JOB REQUIREMENTS MATCH
=========================================

Matched Skills (${candidate.matchedSkills?.length || 0})

${formatList(candidate.matchedSkills, "✓")}


=========================================
COMPLETE SKILL INVENTORY
=========================================

Total Skills Identified:
${candidate.candidateSkills?.length || 0}

${formatList(candidate.candidateSkills)}


=========================================
SKILL GAPS
=========================================

Missing Mandatory Skills:

${formatList(candidate.missingMandatorySkills)}


Missing Preferred Skills:

${formatList(candidate.missingPreferredSkills)}


=========================================
AI EVALUATION REASONING
=========================================

${candidate.reason || "No evaluation reasoning available."}


=========================================
RECRUITER NOTES
=========================================

Strength Areas:

${formatList(candidate.matchedSkills)}


Areas Requiring Attention:

${formatList(candidate.missingPreferredSkills)}


=========================================
SCREENING RESULT
=========================================

The candidate met the qualification criteria used during
the automated screening process and has been included in
the shortlist for recruiter review.

Overall Match Score:
${candidate.overallScore ?? "N/A"}/100

Relevant Experience:
${candidate.candidateExperienceYears ?? "N/A"} Years

Mandatory Skill Gaps:
${candidate.missingMandatorySkills?.length || 0}

Preferred Skill Gaps:
${candidate.missingPreferredSkills?.length || 0}


=========================================
END OF REPORT
=========================================
`.trim();


return [
  {
    json: {
      folderId: folders[department],
      binary: application.binary,
      report
    }
  }
];

  Sale: "1HVyG5hHOeSQu_7srB85JcApVSjKYOVrR",
  Engineering: "1mPR66TfzjaRkYQHPuSy-_mbQbKE3NETb"
};

const application = $('When Application Submitted').first();
const department = application.json["Select Department"];
const candidateName = application.json.Name;


// Read evaluation JSON
const evaluationBinary = $('Convert AI Results to File').first().binary;
const binaryKey = Object.keys(evaluationBinary)[0];

const jsonBuffer = await this.helpers.getBinaryDataBuffer(0, binaryKey);
const evaluationData = JSON.parse(jsonBuffer.toString());

const candidate = evaluationData[0]?.output || {};

const formatList = (items, prefix = "•") =>
  items?.length
    ? items.map(item => `${prefix} ${item}`).join("\n")
    : "None";


const report = `
=========================================
CANDIDATE EVALUATION REPORT
=========================================

Candidate Name:
${candidateName}

=========================================
EVALUATION SUMMARY
=========================================

Overall Match Score:
${candidate.overallScore ?? "N/A"}/100

Qualification Status:
Not Selected for Initial Interview

=========================================

=========================================

Technical Skills Score:
${candidate.technicalSkillsScore ?? "N/A"}/100

Experience Score:
${candidate.experienceScore ?? "N/A"}/100

Responsibilities Score:
${candidate.responsibilitiesScore ?? "N/A"}/100

Education Score:
${candidate.educationScore ?? "N/A"}/100

Soft Skills Score:
${candidate.softSkillsScore ?? "N/A"}/100


=========================================
EXPERIENCE
=========================================

Relevant Experience:
${candidate.candidateExperienceYears ?? "N/A"} Years


=========================================
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
=========================================

${candidate.candidateSummary || "No summary available."}


=========================================
IDENTIFIED SKILLS
=========================================

Matched Skills:

${formatList(candidate.matchedSkills, "✓")}


Complete Skill Inventory:

Total Skills Identified:
${candidate.candidateSkills?.length || 0}

${formatList(candidate.candidateSkills)}


=========================================

=========================================

Missing Mandatory Skills:

${formatList(candidate.missingMandatorySkills)}


Missing Preferred Skills:

=========================================
AI EVALUATION REASONING
=========================================

${candidate.reason || "No evaluation reasoning available."}


=========================================
SCREENING RESULT
=========================================

The candidate did not meet the required criteria for
progression to the next stage of the recruitment process.

Evaluation Summary:

Overall Match Score:
${candidate.overallScore ?? "N/A"}/100

Relevant Experience:
${candidate.candidateExperienceYears ?? "N/A"} Years

Mandatory Skill Gaps:
${candidate.missingMandatorySkills?.length || 0}

Preferred Skill Gaps:
${candidate.missingPreferredSkills?.length || 0}


=========================================
END OF REPORT
=========================================
`.trim();


return [
  {
    json: {
      folderId: rejectedDriveFolder[department],
      binary: application.binary,
      report
    }
  }
];

Fixit Consult Tech

Dear Applicant,

Thank you for your interest in joining Fixit Consult Tech and for taking the time to submit your application.

After carefully reviewing your profile against the current requirements of the role, we regret to inform you that you have not been selected to proceed to the next stage of our hiring process at this time.

This decision was made based on the specific requirements of the position and should not be viewed as a reflection of your overall abilities or potential.

We appreciate the effort you invested in your application and encourage you to apply again for future opportunities that align with your skills and experience.

We sincerely thank you for considering Fixit Consult Tech and wish you every success in your professional journey.


Kind Regards,
Recruitment Team
Fixit Consult Tech
